subject: Upcoming Event: Annual Company Conference
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual company conference is fast approaching. This year's event will be held on October 15th at the Marriott Downtown. We have an exciting agenda planned with keynote speakers, breakout sessions, and networking opportunities. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details in the coming weeks. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
